agent_explanation: Floor bounce injects energy: body falls with conserved energy ~742.78 J to y~0.508 with vy~-38.41 (step 211), then at step 212 is placed at y=0.5 with vy=+62.01 and energy ~1927.58 J. Outgoing speed exceeds incoming magnitude and far exceeds e*incoming (~15.4 for e=0.4), with zero controller work, so collision impulse/positional correction creates ~1185 J. Even e=0 still violates, indicating restitution handling adds energy rather than dissipating.
